13.name: Inkwell
13.why: Ink waiting in the well before the first line of a tale is written.

13.name: Thunderhead
13.why: The dark base of a storm over the harbor, where a chapter darkens before it turns.

13.name: Book Cloth
13.why: The dark cover of a book I have closed and mean to open again.

14.name: Candle Wax
14.why: Wax softened by candlelight over an illuminated page, pale and faintly golden.

14.name: Morning Light
14.why: Early sun across a page, the first light any good story needs.

14.name: Uncut Page
14.why: The untrimmed leaf of a new book, the one I most want to turn.
